During digital subtraction arteriography, dynamic provocative maneuvers were performed by asking the patient to actively dorsiflex the ankle while sequential angiographic images were acquired. Imaging was obtained both in the neutral resting position and during forced dorsiflexion, which reproduced the vascular compression and demonstrated a complete transient occlusion of the popliteal artery.
